members.default: css` :host { display: block; color: #17213a; font: 400 1rem/1.45 system-ui, sans-serif; } article, section { display: grid; gap: .8rem; border: 1px solid #dbe3ef; border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1rem; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgb(15 23 42 / 8%); } header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .75rem; color: #52627a; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; } button, a { min-height: 2.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: .75rem; padding: .7rem 1rem; background: #17213a; color: #fff; font: inherit; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } button:hover:not(:disabled), a:hover { background: #283653; } button:focus-visible, a:focus-visible, input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #38bdf8; outline-offset: 3px; } button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; } input { min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid #b9c7d9; border-radius: .65rem; padding: 0 .75rem; font: inherit; } .badge { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; border-radius: 999px; padding: .25rem .65rem; background: #ecfdf5; color: #047857; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; } .muted { color: #52627a; } `
